podcast.body: Released on February 5th, 1972, this innovative song reached number four on the Billboard Hot 100, notably featuring instrumental tracks recorded in Jamaica with vocals added in New York, and was inspired by Simon contemplating his feelings if his wife, Maggie Harper, died, comparing it to the death of his dog. The title itself was derived from a Chinese food menu item. "Mother and child reunion with instrumental recorded in Jamaica and vocals in New York released on February 5th, 1972 and made it to number four on the Billboard Hot 100."
